description: This file defines inline functions related to memory mapping and register checks for the RTL838X hardware platform in the Linux kernel. It includes functions to identify internal register regions and to map or unmap IO memory addresses.

methods.name: int is_rtl838x_internal_registers(phys_addr_t offset)
methods.description: Determines if a given physical address offset corresponds to internal register regions specific to RTL838X hardware.

methods.name: void __iomem * plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset,unsigned long size,unsigned long flags)
methods.description: Returns a mapped IO memory pointer for a given physical address offset if it corresponds to internal registers; otherwise, returns NULL.

methods.name: int plat_iounmap(const volatile void __iomem * addr)
methods.description: Checks if a given IO memory address is within internal register regions, effectively unmapping it.

ctags.name: plat_ioremap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void __iomem *plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset, unsigned long size,$/
